networkAccess.reasoning: Reads the typographic scales the user saved on typescalegarden.uy, plus the public Google Fonts catalogue the plugin needs to work out which weights each font offers. Pairing is opt-in: the user copies a short code from the website, and the token the plugin receives in exchange can only read typescales — it cannot create, change or delete anything. sentry.io receives crash reports when the plugin hits an error: the error message, where in the plugin it happened, and the font family involved. No document contents, no personal data and no credentials are sent.
